assessment.basis: Coefficients and plotted energy-volume curves are published, but the numerical grid is not deposited; independent equation checkpoints verify transcription without claiming a refit.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the author-repository primary PDF; LitCurate was used only for discovery and row enumeration.

primary_source_check.finding: Table I supplies a complete high-spin BM3 parameterization after converting its formula-unit volume; the corresponding low-spin row has no reported low-spin V0 and was rejected.

primary_data_check.finding: Coefficients and plotted energy-volume curves are published, but the numerical grid is not deposited; independent equation checkpoints verify transcription without claiming a refit.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Calculated states/theory determine this EOS; source: Methods; Table I; Figures 1-4.
parameter_provenance.equation: Methods: third-order Birch-Murnaghan fit to the DFT+DMFT total-energy results.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table I: 141.3 bohr^3/formula unit, converted to a conventional Z=4 cell with the exact Bohr definition.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table I: fixed to 4.1 for every composition.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: High-spin volume region fitted separately from the low-spin region; the numerical energy-volume grid is not deposited.

superseded_record_text.label: (Mg0.25Fe0.75)O B1 magnesiowustite, Leonov et al. (2017) high-spin BM3
